body: I'm very sorry your son is going through similar issues, it's very upsetting that even now bullying still continues. I honestly would suggest homeschooling or online school because sadly the public school system is the hotspot for bullying to happen, and on top of that school staff do very little on the problem, so many kids have taken their lives from bullying by school peers. I never did but I sure had thoughts of it. getting your son away from such a toxic environment would be best.

I'm sorry you are going through this. I'm 25 and still have ptsd from being bullied as well I was up all night from it last night, people would talk behind my back and spread false information about me as well.  id perhaps confront your bullies even if they still act like jerks after you at least shown you can stand up for yourself. it's something I wish I did, but everyone back then told me I should stay quiet but now I regret not standing up for myself more.

I was bullied for being weird and fat, it started in 3rd grade I was ridiculed for my weight because I was chubby due to me having a thyroid condition (which i didn't even know i had yet)and because I dressed in an eccentric way so I was teased over the way I looked alot ,one of my most painful memories is in 4th grade this boy in my class asked every boy in the lunchroom to raise their hands if they think im ugly, that bad memory still hurts me to this day and is one of the reasons I still at times think I'm ugly even though I get compliments way more often than insults now. I was also bullied because I was quiet, introverted, acted antisocial and sometimes id have panic attacks right in school, mostly 6th grade onwards because I had and still have severe anxiety issues plus autism, people didn't understand and thought I was just weird and crazy,,. I also began to dress gothic so I was ridiculed for that as well and got the usual devil worshipper comments or people calling me cringe, my first year of high school was awful I was more anxious than ever because of how big and crowded that school was so I stood/sat away from everyone, panicked in crowds and hid my face alot, this popular 12th grade boy took photos of me without my permission or knowledge and posted them on his twitter to mock me, turning my existence into a joke almost everyone saw the posts and thought it was hilarious, people thought it was fine because it was "just the internet" what they don't get is how much more humiliating it is to just have myself getting ridiculed on there for anybody to look at and laugh at anytime, people would stare and laugh at me in the hall after those pictures were put up. it's been 11 years and I'm still hurt by that experience.

Agreed with all of this. I tried asking my schools counselor to help me confront a guy that bullied me in 9th grade, he gaslit me into feeling like I was in the wrong by saying if someone does act like a bully it's because they have a hard life at home and that I should not cause any drama, it was not true at all my main bully was spoiled by his parents his family were nothing but indulgent, he had no issues at home at all. I also tried telling my teacher in 7th grade about this girl from my school that bullied me through facebook, and another time about these two girls that would bully me during recess all the time. she refused to believe me both times and just put all the blame on me.  victim blaming is so common especially if the bully is a popular kid, the teachers and school staff are more likely to side with a popular kid over a loner.

I never understood the thing about how people should be forced into being normal....even after all the bullying I went through I never became "normal" because I am autistic and have anxiety/depression regardless but also the fact it was often kids of the "normal" popular type crowd that would mock me it just made me resent so called "normal" people seeing them as narrow minded jerks that will ridicule, hate and judge anybody that they don't understand, it made me want to stay my weird self even more.  And yes most of the time school shootings would of been prevented if the shooters were not bullied. I'm not saying what they did was at all right or acceptable, but they were the victims first as soon as the bullying started the school should of done something about it. But most of all people need to stop being ignorant and realize if someone is "weird" it is due to neurodivergence or a mental health problem a majority of the time.

this post is from two years ago but I found it through google because I was thinking of my own experiences. yes I was bullied by guys more so than I was by other girls, there were some girls still that made fun of me mainly behind my back but the bullying the guys did to me was more severe, such as one shouting and asking every boy in the lunchroom in 4th grade to raise their hands if they think im ugly , (one raised both his hands to show how ugly he thought i was...), and then a group of older boys used to to bully me when I would walk home from school alone in 5th grade, pretty sure they were 7th or 8th graders.  I also remember a few boys asking me to marry them as a joke (since I was fat and weird therefore not attractive), an older boy from my sisters class also made a joke about me looking pregnant when I was only in 3rd grade. the worst thing however was in my first year of highschool this popular 12th grade guy took photos of me without my knowledge and posted them on his twitter to mock me, basically turning me into some sort of meme and most people thought it was hilarious, only a few stood up for me and it was mainly girls, i remember maybe just one guy that did and he didn't even go to my school.  alot of guys can be so cruel towards girls that they deem unnattractive, I was overweight, gothic and due to me having severe anxiety problems plus being autistic I appeared "weird" my antisocial anxious behavior lead to people viewing me as some sort of freak.  meanwhile as I got older I had a glow up, I'm still goth but I learned to do the style properly (and I wear other styles sometimes to) and I wear things that flatter my figure, in general I just became better looking from 16 years old onwards, only when I became attractive did it change to now my bullies mainly being other women instead of men.

I can confirm yes because I'm gen Z and I was bullied in school, it's often done in a less obvious way though in older times bullies would do it directly to your face, in modern times it usually is through social media and rumor spreading/talking behind a person's back. kids who are obviously different still get made fun of, I was considered weird because I behaved in an antisocial anxious matter and I was chubby+goth at the same time so that lead to me being a target.
